explanation: A king of Judah who reigned for 16 years and did what was evil in the Lord's sight.
An Old Testament kingdom, also known as the Southern Kingdom, named after Jacob's son Judah.
A country in the Middle East that attacked and conquered parts of Judah during Ahas' time.
An Old Testament kingdom south of Judah, inhabited by descendants of Esau, Jacob's brother.
A people who lived in the area along the Mediterranean coast, southwest of Judah. They were often in conflict with the Israelites.
To show reverence and devotion to a deity or higher power.
False gods or statues that people worship instead of the true God.
A title used to refer to God, especially in the Old Testament.
A person who speaks on behalf of God and delivers his message to the people.
An act where something is given up, often an animal, as a gift to a deity to seek grace, forgiveness, or blessing.
